2116991729660575998.en_summary: Elon Musk states the other supercompute projects are unable to reach their goals, but SpaceX is already achieving ours. Quoted post describes SpaceXAI’s Colossus 2 in Memphis as the world’s most powerful AI data center with roughly 1.11 million H100 equivalents, ahead of OpenAI’s Stargate, expected to widen gap by mid 2027 with more Blackwell clusters.
2116991729660575998.zh_summary: Elon Musk 表示其他超級運算項目無法達到目標，但 SpaceX 已經在實現我們的目標。引用帖描述 SpaceXAI 在孟菲斯的 Colossus 2 是世界最強大的 AI 數據中心，約有 111 萬個 H100 等效，領先 OpenAI 的 Stargate，預計到 2027 年中將有更多 Blackwell 集群進一步拉開差距。

ticker_notes.SPCX: SpaceX achieving supercompute goals; Colossus 2 is world's most powerful AI data center with 1.11M H100 equivalents

2116979856688734681.en_summary: Michael A. Gayed notes JOJO.Index = ATAC Credit-On/Credit-Off Index, launched 6/14/2021. Results before launch are backtested and hypothetical. Indexes are unmanaged, have no fees and cannot be invested in directly. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Not investment advice.
2116979856688734681.zh_summary: Michael A. Gayed 指出 JOJO.Index 為 ATAC Credit-On/Credit-Off Index，於 2021 年 6 月 14 日推出。推出前結果為回測及假設。指數無管理、無費用，不能直接投資。過去表現不保證未來結果。非投資建議。

2116979853979217999.en_summary: Michael A. Gayed shares full global financial crisis backtest for JOJO.Index: 75 weeks, credit-off for 44 of them. Oct 9, 2007 to Mar 9, 2009: S&P 500 -55.19%, high yield -32.87%. The JOJO.Index: +5.19%. It still had a -25.32% drawdown along the way. Not painless, just less painful.
2116979853979217999.zh_summary: Michael A. Gayed 分享 JOJO.Index 在完整全球金融危機的回測：75 週中有 44 週處於信用關閉。2007 年 10 月 9 日至 2009 年 3 月 9 日：標普500 -55.19%，高收益債 -32.87%。JOJO.Index：+5.19%。過程中仍有 -25.32% 的回撤。並非無痛，只是較少痛苦。

2116971468630507657.en_summary: Javier Blas quotes sources saying Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike Iran immediately after the midterm elections on Tuesday. But Trump, for now, wants to let negotiations play out — a strategy Netanyahu is concerned about. Quoted from Axios story on Trump-Netanyahu call about U.S.-Iran negotiations and war moves.
2116971468630507657.zh_summary: Javier Blas 引用消息人士稱 Netanyahu 正在敦促 Trump 在星期二中期選舉後立即打擊伊朗。但 Trump 目前希望讓談判進行——這是 Netanyahu 所擔憂的策略。引用 Axios 關於 Trump 與 Netanyahu 通話討論美伊談判及戰爭下一步的報導。

2116940466612564231.en_summary: tae kim agrees that many investors still keep forgetting that search and ads are 75%+ of Google’s revenues and 90%+ of profits. Cloud and TPUs can’t make up for that. So as personal agents take off, AI models won’t save Google and Gemini in the consumers app has to deliver.
2116940466612564231.zh_summary: tae kim 同意許多投資者仍忘記搜尋和廣告佔 Google 收入的 75% 以上及利潤的 90% 以上。雲端和 TPU 無法補償。因此隨著個人代理起飛，AI 模型無法拯救 Google，Gemini 在消費者應用中必須交付成果。

ticker_notes.GOOG: Search and ads are 75%+ revenues and 90%+ profits; Cloud/TPUs can't compensate; AI models won't save if personal agents take off
